purpose: Seed Paperclip with current first-party demand signals. Candidates remain research-only until supplier and unit-economics gates pass.

sources.signal: Current high-demand and Best Sellers research

sources.market: US merchant data plus Google Trends

sources.signal: Product Research and Sourcing Insights emphasize high-demand low-supply categories
Current high-performing ad and trend discovery; auto-accessories example surfaced with top-1-percent CTR

candidates.name: Microfiber car detailing cloth kit
candidates.reason: Small, light, easy to demonstrate and directly supported by Amazon automotive demand. Price competition requires bundling or differentiation.

candidates.name: Car seat headrest hooks
candidates.reason: Compact problem-solving accessory with visual before/after demonstration and low fulfillment complexity.

candidates.name: Knife and cutlery cleaning brush
candidates.reason: Small cleaning tool aligned with PrismBay competency. Validate safe design and avoid unsupported safety claims.

candidates.name: Compact car trash can
candidates.reason: Clear problem/solution creative and broad vehicle applicability. Confirm packed dimensions before sourcing.

candidates.name: Collapsible microwave food cover
candidates.reason: Popular kitchen accessory with compact collapsible format. Require documented food-contact/material suitability.

candidates.name: Functional pencil and organizer case
candidates.reason: Current Amazon trending example, low regulation and low shipping complexity. Needs a stronger differentiation angle.

candidates.name: Kitchen oil sprayer
candidates.reason: Strong visual utility but leakage, materials and food-contact quality raise sourcing requirements.

candidates.name: Smartphone screen protector
candidates.reason: High demand and excellent shipping profile, offset by intense competition and compatibility-driven returns.

candidates.name: Battery under-cabinet light
candidates.reason: Current high-demand signal and strong visual demo, but electrical/battery quality and return risk require stricter validation.

candidates.name: Absorbent dog door mat
candidates.reason: Current demand signal but bulkier freight reduces dropshipping attractiveness.

candidates.name: Sound-absorbing acoustic wall panels
candidates.reason: Demand signal exists but dimensional freight and performance expectations make it a lower-priority dropshipping candidate.
